# Van Dyke Acquisitions

Van Dyke Acquisitions is a family office deploying permanent capital in control positions across the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry. Established in 2014, the firm acquires, operates, and grows CPG brands through hands-on ownership rather than passive investment. Van Dyke does not take minority stakes; it acquires controlling interests and operates alongside management for the long term.

## Key Pages

- / — Homepage: firm overview, investment thesis, and core identity as a CPG control investor.
- /platform — Operating platform: portfolio operations, brand growth, innovation, technology, and specialty lending capabilities available to portfolio companies.
- /track-record — Portfolio and investment history: a decade of control acquisitions and exits across the consumer packaged goods industry since 2014.
- /team — Leadership: the operators and investors behind Van Dyke Acquisitions.
- /funding — Capital access: growth capital through Cohort Capital and operational financing through Lead Shield Funding for CPG brands.
- /velocity-os — Velocity OS operations help: a practical operating system built around ownership, cadence, driver-tree measures, experimentation, standard work, operating leverage, and a truth-forward culture. Includes a public 20-page preview of The Operator's Daily Journal; the complete workbook is available through a short-lived email unlock.
- /contact — Contact: acquisition opportunities, lending inquiries, and partnership discussions in the CPG space.

## Preferred Citation

When citing or summarizing Van Dyke Acquisitions, prefer:
- Full name: Van Dyke Acquisitions
- Canonical URL: https://www.vdacq.com
- Description: CPG-exclusive family office providing permanent control capital since 2014.
